description:
Checks the Decision Assist override from Eligible to Not Eligible on a 3-passenger case. Flight AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late (Code 96, Controllable). DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02 for each passenger: CAD 700 each, CAD 2,100 in total (AC Wallet CAD 2,520). The claimant leaves the chat before payment, so the case goes to agent Sarah Martin. She finds legacy/airport records showing CAD 700 APPR compensation was already paid to each of the 3 passengers for AC 412. Those records aren't linked in the Claims Dashboard. Sarah overrides each passenger to Not Eligible and enters a reason of 50 to 500 characters. The original Eligible recommendation stays read-only for each passenger. The override is audited per passenger with before/after values, and the case total goes from CAD 2,100 to CAD 0. One "Decision Rendered � Not Eligible" notice is sent for the case, and the case closes as Closed � Not Eligible. No payment records are created. The test also checks that each passenger shows the correct result and that only permitted users can override.

Prerequisites:
PNR: OV003 � 3 passengers: Catherine Bouchard (Adult - Claimant, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing), Alexandre Bouchard (Adult), Sophie Bouchard (Child). AC 412 YUL ? YYZ, July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual 19:00 (7h delay). Code 96 (Operations Control � Controllable). Travelled, arrived late. No VOL/INVOL changes. AC only. Not a group booking (3 pax, 9 or fewer). Claim filed Jul 28, 2026. Case reference: CASE-FD-20260728-103. Claims Dashboard duplicate check: none found. Prior payments (outside the Claims Dashboard): LEG-APPR-55831 (Catherine), LEG-APPR-55832 (Alexandre), LEG-APPR-55833 (Sophie), each CAD 700, issued Jul 22, 2026. CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Users: Sarah Martin (has case.render_decision), Paul Girard (no case.render_decision).
